summary: Anthropic states it received a US government export control directive ordering it to suspend all access to its Fable 5 and Mythos 5 models for foreign nationals, forcing it to disable both models for all customers.

mechanisms.reason: A government export control directive forces the lab to cut off access to two deployed models on national-security grounds.
mechanisms.quote: The US government, citing national security authorities, has issued an export control directive to suspend all access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 by any foreign national, whether inside or outside the United States, including foreign national Anthropic employees.

mechanisms.reason: Two commercially deployed models used by hundreds of millions of people are being abruptly disabled for all customers, directly reducing served inference volume.
mechanisms.quote: The net effect of this order is that we must abruptly disable Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for all our customers to ensure compliance.

practices.reason: Any team integrated with Fable 5 or Mythos 5 must immediately migrate off the disabled models with no advance notice.
practices.quote: We are complying with the government’s legal directive and are removing access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for all users.

practices.reason: The post describes Anthropic's internal red-teaming and defense-in-depth methodology for jailbreak resistance, informative but not a transferable instrument for outside teams.
practices.quote: In the weeks leading up to the launch of Fable, Anthropic worked with the US government, the UK AISI, multiple private third-party organizations and internal teams to red-team Fable’s safeguards for thousands of hours in total.

notable_reason: A US government directive forcing a frontier lab to suspend two live commercial models over an alleged jailbreak is an unprecedented regulatory intervention in deployed AI systems.
